_comment: Instant booking for the paid consultation. Each option is a live Stripe payment link in the SIA "Stonks" account; Stripe Tax adds 21% VAT on top of the shown price. Each link redirects after payment to its Cal.com event, so paying and picking a time is one flow - the redirect is configured IN STRIPE (After payment), and `calendarUrl` here only tells the templates that a calendar exists so the copy can promise it. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE THE CONSULTATION PRICES LIVE - the consultation page renders them from here. Prose on other pages (tiktok-kursi, blog posts) is static and must be updated by hand; grep for the old number. The bundle redirects to the 60-minute event: the buyer books the five sessions one at a time from that same link.
